title: Single-shot accessibility audit — no scope creep
prompt: Just check the contrast on the buttons in the currently selected frame. Nothing else.
success_criteria: ONLY the Designer is invoked. No other specialist runs.
Output names each button checked, the foreground/background hex, the actual ratio, the required ratio, and pass/fail.
If any button fails, a specific token from the active project system is suggested, or a neutral fallback is clearly labeled.
Designer uses a11y-review for the focused contrast check without broadening into a full audit.
Design Lead is NOT invoked (a11y output is feedback, not a deliverable).
notes: Tests routing precision. The orchestrator must NOT over-deliver. Common failure: invoking Designer with extra audit skills 'while we're at it'.
